title: EasyGame
description: Lots of stuff that helps you beat the game without cheating!
body:
# What does EasyGame do?
EasyGame is made to make Survival Mode simpler and adds new features to the game that are not considered cheats.
# Cheats?
This mod is not a cheat/xray mod, it helps you to beat the game a little easier without giving you qualities of Operator Powers/Commands. There are no cheats in this mod.
# What stuff is there in EasyGame?
There are things like multiple step processes of smelting, crafting, and stonecutting to make things that combine to make a good item, like one of the items, stringy leather, which can be used with leather below in a crafting table to make a bundle! And there will be so much more.
